 Vivo Y600 Specs Leak: 10,000mAh Battery with record-breaking endurance
 Kreso | 22/10/2026 | Android | No Comments 
 Vivo is preparing to expand its extensive Y600 series in China with a new base model, the Vivo Y600, anchored by a massive 10,000mAh BlueVolt battery that has already secured a Guinness World Record for endurance.
 Official promotional materials confirm the device’s extreme battery capacity, highlighting a grueling endurance test conducted on August 11, 2026. During the trial, the Vivo Y600 managed a continuous mobile phone livestream lasting 32 hours and 37 minutes, earning official Guinness World Records recognition before the device has even hit retail shelves.
 While Vivo is currently keeping the rest of the official specification sheet under wraps, prominent Weibo tipster Experience More has leaked several key hardware details. The upcoming device will reportedly be powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 7300e chipset and feature a 50-megapixel primary rear camera. Furthermore, a recent 3C certification listing under the model number V2607A corroborates that the phone will support 44W wired fast charging. The device is also expected to carry robust IP68 and IP69 ratings, ensuring top-tier resistance against dust, submersion, and high-pressure water jets.
 Industry analysts suggest the Vivo Y600 could be a domesticated rebrand of the Vivo S2 FE, which recently debuted in India, or the Vivo V80 Lite 5G available in Southeast Asian markets. If this hardware alignment proves accurate, consumers can expect the Y600 to feature a sprawling 6.83-inch AMOLED display with a 1.5K resolution and a fluid 120Hz refresh rate.

 Vivo has not yet announced an official launch date, regional availability, or pricing structure for the Y600. The device will join an already crowded domestic lineup that includes the Y600 Pro, Y600 Turbo, Y600i, Y600k Turbo, and Y600s Pro.
